content: पुत्रः .²1 A son; (the word is thus derived:-- पुन्नाम्नो नरकाद् यस्मात् त्रायते पितरं सुतः . तस्मात् पुत्र इति प्रोक्तः स्वयमेव स्वयंभुवा . <ls>Ms. 9. 138</ls>; the word, therefore, should be strictly written पुत्त्रः). .²2 A child, young one of an animal. .²3 A dear child (a term of endearment in addressing young persons). .²4 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Anything little or small of its kind; as in असिपुत्रः, शिलापुत्रः <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 (<ab>Astrol.</ab>) The fifth mansion from जन्मलग्न. .{@-त्रौ@} (<ab>du.</ab>) A son and daughter.
